geometry_analysis.width_description: Width appears uniform, but the actual toe boundaries are obscured by thick slag layers.
geometry_analysis.surface_profile: Convex reinforcement; effectively visually narrowed by the slag borders.

visual_anomalies.visual_description: Thick, continuous bands of dark brown/black non-metallic material (solidified slag) covering the entire length of both Top and Bottom Toes. It creates a 'framed' appearance.
visual_anomalies.visual_severity: High; completely obstructs inspection of the toe fusion zone

visual_anomalies.visual_description: The transition between the slag crust and the exposed weld metal creates a jagged, irregular surface profile.
Because the toes are covered by slag, the contour can only be judged partially; the visible profile appears convex with locally steep transitions.

surface_state.spatter_distribution: Fine particles on the base metal
surface_state.discoloration: Dominant dark brown slag crust contrasting with the bright metallic center
